Map Of USA Senators By Party Affiliation From 1789 To 2017

This is I created timelapse showing history of USA Senate, how they swithed from party to party over time. For this projekt I decided to split all states into two parts to show both of two seats each state have. I find this method more useful than using stripes ar mixed color (aka purple for dem/gop) in times when state senators were from different parties, also this way I could show the history of each individual seat so I put numbers denoting which senate classes seats belong to. If you dont know senate classes are for determining when particular senator face re-election. All classes have re-elections two years apart or put it other way one third of senate is elected every two years. This video also show senate vacancies, but only long ones (nearly a year, years), vacancies that only lasted days, weeks or a few months arent shown due to timeframe of my gif being one year althrought there were many of them in almost all states. I also added names of serving presidents and vice presidents (vices are presidents of the senate so I figured I will add them as well) in each frame (hope that helps). Senate majority leaders only appear 1920s because that title didnt exist before 1920s.
